<p dir="auto">The OpenAI Agents SDK is a lightweight yet powerful framework for building multi-agent workflows. It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.</p>

<ol dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/agents" rel="nofollow"><strong>Agents</strong></a>: LLMs configured with instructions, tools, guardrails, and handoffs</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/sandbox_agents" rel="nofollow"><strong>Sandbox agents</strong></a>: Agents preconfigured to work with a container to perform work over long time horizons.</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/realtime/quickstart/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Realtime agents</strong></a>: Build powerful voice agents with <code>gpt-realtime-2.1</code> and full agent features</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/voice/quickstart/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Voice agents</strong></a>: Build voice pipelines that combine speech-to-text, an agent workflow, and text-to-speech</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/tools/#agents-as-tools" rel="nofollow">Agents as tools</a> / <a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/handoffs/" rel="nofollow">Handoffs</a></strong>: Delegating to other agents for specific tasks</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/tools/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Tools</strong></a>: Various Tools let agents take actions (functions, MCP, hosted tools)</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/guardrails/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Guardrails</strong></a>: Configurable safety checks for input and output validation</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/human_in_the_loop/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Human in the loop</strong></a>: Built-in mechanisms for involving humans across agent runs</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/sessions/" rel="nofollow"><strong>Sessions</strong></a>: Automatic conversation history management across agent runs</li>

<p dir="auto">Use a <a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/sandbox_agents" rel="nofollow"><code>SandboxAgent</code></a> when the agent needs to inspect files, run commands, apply patches, or preserve workspace state across longer tasks.</p>
<p dir="auto">This example uses <code>UnixLocalSandboxClient</code>, which is supported on macOS and Linux. On Windows, use <code>DockerSandboxClient</code> with the <code>openai-agents[docker]</code> extra or a hosted sandbox client instead; see <a href="https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-python/sandbox/clients/" rel="nofollow">Sandbox clients</a> for setup details.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agents</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Runner</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agents</span>.<span class="pl-s1">run</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">RunConfig</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agents</span>.<span class="pl-s1">sandbox</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Manifest</span>, <span class="pl-v">SandboxAgent</span>, <span class="pl-v">SandboxRunConfig</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agents</span>.<span class="pl-s1">sandbox</span>.<span class="pl-s1">entries</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">GitRepo</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">agents</span>.<span class="pl-s1">sandbox</span>.<span class="pl-s1">sandboxes</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">UnixLocalSandboxClient</span>

<span class="pl-s1">agent</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">SandboxAgent</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">name</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"Workspace Assistant"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">instructions</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"Inspect the sandbox workspace before answering."</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">default_manifest</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-en">Manifest</span>(<span class="pl-s1">entries</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>{<span class="pl-s">"repo"</span>: <span class="pl-en">GitRepo</span>(<span class="pl-s1">repo</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"openai/openai-agents-python"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">ref</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"main"</span>)}),
)

<span class="pl-s1">result</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-v">Runner</span>.<span class="pl-c1">run_sync</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">agent</span>,
    <span class="pl-s">"Inspect the repo README and summarize what this project does."</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">run_config</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-en">RunConfig</span>(<span class="pl-s1">sandbox</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-en">SandboxRunConfig</span>(<span class="pl-s1">client</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-en">UnixLocalSandboxClient</span>())),
)
<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">result</span>.<span class="pl-c1">final_output</span>)</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="from agents import Runner
from agents.run import RunConfig
from agents.sandbox import Manifest, SandboxAgent, SandboxRunConfig
from agents.sandbox.entries import GitRepo
from agents.sandbox.sandboxes import UnixLocalSandboxClient

agent = SandboxAgent(
    name="Workspace Assistant",
    instructions="Inspect the sandbox workspace before answering.",
    default_manifest=Manifest(entries={"repo": GitRepo(repo="openai/openai-agents-python", ref="main")}),
)

result = Runner.run_sync(
    agent,
    "Inspect the repo README and summarize what this project does.",
    run_config=RunConfig(sandbox=SandboxRunConfig(client=UnixLocalSandboxClient())),
)
print(result.final_output)" tabindex="0" role="button">

from agents.realtime import RealtimeAgent, RealtimeRunner

async def main() -> None:
    agent = RealtimeAgent(name="Assistant", instructions="You are a helpful voice assistant. Keep responses short.")
    runner = RealtimeRunner(starting_agent=agent)
    session = await runner.run()

    async with session:
        await session.send_message("Say hello in one short sentence.")
        async for event in session:

            elif event.type == "history_added":

            <span class="pl-k">pass</span>


<span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-s1">__name__</span> <span class="pl-c1">==</span> <span class="pl-s">"__main__"</span>:

import numpy as np

from agents import Agent
from agents.voice import AudioInput, SingleAgentVoiceWorkflow, VoicePipeline


async def main() -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="Assistant", instructions="You are a helpful voice assistant.")
    pipeline = VoicePipeline(workflow=SingleAgentVoiceWorkflow(agent))
    audio_input = AudioInput(buffer=np.zeros(24000 * 3, dtype=np.int16))

    result = await pipeline.run(audio_input)
    async for event in result.stream():
        if event.type == "voice_stream_event_audio":
            # Forward or play event.data.
            pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())" tabindex="0" role="button">
